verdict.rationale: Cekura's own docs say cron jobs run scheduled calls and "alert you if things fail" [cekura-docs-62]. Its marketing claims "live drift detection across every call" and automatic issue flagging [cekura-docs-20, cekura-docs-21], which loosely covers eval-score degradation alerting. Nothing in the evidence shows user-configurable alert thresholds on error rates, cost spikes, or eval scores, or which channels deliver notifications. Missing for 10: configurable threshold alerts on error rate, cost, and eval-score metrics; documented Slack, PagerDuty, or email notification channels; detail beyond a one-line cron-alert mention and marketing claims; independent or hands-on corroboration.
